entries.text: The current profile's menu on the Profiles page opens its details: counts, subscription and external resources
The Windows installer offers Chinese, and the README has a Chinese translation (#153)
Dashboard cards you arranged stay put when the subscription updates, unless the panel denies editing them
TUN on Linux reports a Core the Helper refuses instead of failing silently, and AUR packages no longer break the Core's checksum (#156)
Rules added to a profile can target its proxy groups again (#154)
The update reminder's Hide skips only that release, and the download shows its progress in the Download button
Windows devices send the same HWID as in FlClashX 0.4 again, so a device limit no longer counts them twice
The wide dashboard on desktop and TV shows the cards flclashx-widgets picks, in its order, and can be edited
Pre-releases install as a separate FlClashX Pre app and copy the stable app's profiles on first launch
Proxy chains (beta): route a group through two or three hops from the profile's extension page
A hidden outbound IP is left out rather than shown as asterisks, and the dashboard's server name takes over switching the server; Hide IP has its own switch on the Theme page
An update from a provider's mirror installs only when FlClashX signed it, so a mirror cannot hand out another build
Updates can come from a provider's own mirror named in the subscription
Updates download inside the app, are checked against the release's checksum and signing identity, and install with one tap
Backups now include the proxy chains of each profile
Added rules of a profile can now send traffic through its proxy chains
A panel that stops sending hideip or novibrate shows the IP and turns vibration back on
On Android TV, Back from the dashboard keeps the VPN running, and the bundled Zashboard no longer gives way to an old MetaCubeXD
A profile QR code can be read from an image on Windows and Linux again
The proxy chains section no longer shows two add buttons while it is empty
Switching or applying a profile while it was still loading no longer fails with a disposed-ref error
Custom overwrites are removed; rebuild them as custom profiles
The DNS and NTP override toggles are removed; DNS, NTP, sniffer and TUN are set per key, and picked keys apply to every profile
Desktop TUN settings follow the profile until you pick them; values you changed carry over
Settings the subscription sets belong to the provider; each one can be taken over and handed back
TLS certificates are always checked; the toggle to turn the check off is gone
Built on FlClash 0.9.2 with the mihomo v1.19.34 core
Subscription headers: flclashx-view, widgets, settings, special, newdomain, service name and logo, serverinfo, buyplan, buytraffic and background
hideip hides the outbound IP, and app.theme lets the panel set the app theme
flclashx-override works on the profile's own GLOBAL group
Subscription expiry notices; the renewal button appears on its day without waiting for an update
External controller and Zashboard from the subscription
Group and server descriptions; a group's description shows in place of the node it picked
The subscription's authentication sets the proxy account
App links add a profile without a confirmation and say so
Every setting the config names (ports, mode, TUN, stack, MTU, congestion control, routes, geo and more) is locked to the provider: a closed lock marks the provider's, an open one yours
Take any provider setting over and hand it back one at a time; settings the config leaves out stay yours
Panel header settings apply once per subscription update or profile switch
strict as a third process-finding mode
iOS-style interface: stretchy stacked sheets, context menus and slide-to-pick, drag to go back, docked search and long-press reordering
Sidebar and floating dock; bar buttons lift on hover
Optional two-tier Liquid Glass with frosted dashboard cards, sheets and setting groups, stepping down for good, and out of the subscription's hands, when the GPU falls behind
Redesigned theme colors, a higher-contrast dark mode, a refreshed app icon, new glyphs, empty states and theme page
French, Spanish and Korean translations, seven languages in all, and a reviewed Russian translation
A redesigned dashboard around the current exit, with more cards and IP quality cached for 3 days
Enhanced view on new installs; movable status card and announcement
Provider logo and name on one row, with the logo cached on disk
Tapping the delay opens the server picker; core restart button, now on Android too
Service checks through the proxy for Gosuslugi, Sberbank, VK, Yandex and Kinopoisk, and outbound IP risk kept off Cloudflare
Groups as cards and group tabs as chips
Search, mode, test all and fold all in one button group, the rest under More; expand or collapse every group at once
Hide timed-out nodes and search every list
Add proxies to local proxies; adjustable delay test timeout
A profile just added opens on its first group
Custom profiles, with include-all in custom groups
Profile QR codes and phone-to-TV links
Share link import, .mrs rule sets and more proxy fields
Word wrap and snippets
DNS, NTP, sniffer and TUN set per key; DNS, Hosts and ports apply without a restart; optional general overrides
DNS query log; clear the DNS cache by hand or on a network change
Sortable tables for connections, requests and DNS; recent requests and live connections on one page; punycode hosts shown in Unicode
mihomo v1.19.34: Firefox 148 and Safari 26.3 TLS fingerprints, Snell v6 and several users on a Shadowsocks listener
A crashed desktop Core restarts on its own, at most twice in a row, and names the cause
A rising vibration as the app opens; holding the start/stop button for five seconds toggles the proxy under a rising vibration
Constant 120 Hz; the Core runs in its own process and restarts without restarting the app
The VPN notification shows the service or profile name, optionally with a stop button only
TUN include and exclude packages always apply and override access control; smart selection of Russian apps and a status bar in access control; TUN routes from the subscription
Launcher shortcuts and one-step on-demand access; no Firebase analytics or crash reporting
Share today's logs from the settings
Says why the VPN did not start when its permission is refused, pointing Android 17 users at the Nearby devices permission
The first window opens in the phone layout at the top of the screen, so it can always be moved on small screens
Colored tray status icons with a monochrome option on macOS; tray hotkeys, nodes and a delay test
File logs and app reset; no China presets; disclaimer and About updated; README rewritten with the subscription headers documented on flclashx.app
Profiles and settings carry over from FlClashX 0.4 on macOS
A one-line proxy card size, also set by proxies.card:oneline
A switch turns vibration off, and a panel can turn it off with novibrate

An animated GIF or WebP works as the panel background; animated WebP is recommended, being several times smaller than a GIF. It stops on its first frame under reduced motion or when the GPU falls behind
Updating a subscription no longer switches url-test and fallback groups to a dead first node
A node picked while a subscription update applies is no longer lost
Load balancers are tested by their nodes, and groups without a URL by the app's test URL, without doubled pings
A profile chosen while the app is still starting is no longer ignored, and changes typed during a save are kept
Long-lived connections keep their route; traffic of a UDP session that moved routes is counted on the new route at once
A rule set or geo download past 128 MiB, a malformed .mrs file or a profile with runaway YAML aliases can no longer exhaust memory or freeze the app
Updating the GeoIP or ASN database no longer risks crashing the Core
A damaged or oversized backup is rejected instead of restored
A VPN start from Quick Settings while the app is starting is no longer lost, and opening the app no longer reloads a running VPN
A start cancelled right before the VPN permission prompt no longer blocks later starts
A stop on an excluded Wi-Fi network keeps the VPN off after leaving it, and VPN settings changed before exiting apply to the next Quick Settings start
Per-app rules on Android 7–9 no longer apply another app's policy to a shared UDP socket
Making the window narrow no longer closes an open profile editor or loses its changes
A system proxy FlClashX did not set is left alone; it is released while the Core is down and cleared after a crashed or killed run
A desktop TUN that fails to start is reported and turned off instead of showing as on
TUN runs through a root-owned copy of the Core outside the app and no longer fails after the password prompt
The menu bar popover survives a Dock reopen; logout, restart and shutdown are no longer cancelled; launch at login works on macOS 12; tray groups are capped at 100 nodes
TUN without systemd runs through a per-user copy of the Core and no longer locks other users out; the AppImage starts again
The Helper and client shut down fully before installing, and a stale system proxy is cleared
Many fixes to the interface, keyboard and TV remote focus, and to keeping data through downloads, backups and header updates
Any Android APK now installs over any earlier one, whichever ABI variant either is
The VPN follows a move from one Wi-Fi network to another when networks are excluded
The Linux RPM and AppImage start on desktops that have no AppIndicator library installed
The Windows installer upgrades a 0.4 install in place instead of installing beside it
The copied proxy variable on Windows works when pasted into PowerShell
Stopping the system proxy on macOS no longer turns off an automatic proxy (PAC) configuration
An upgrade from 0.4 keeps a rule list that replaced the subscription's rules
An upgrade from 0.4 keeps running the selected script
An upgrade from 0.4 keeps the settings its override switches protected from the subscription
Smoother editing of large files; a bracket next to the cursor or thousands of same-named share links no longer stall it
Quick Edit no longer freezes the app on very long rule lists
Smoother UI while the proxy is busy
